title: SmartSubs Pro v2.10.0
notes: Edit your captions before they go on the timeline: remove and restore them, add new ones (at the playhead or in a pause), split and merge them, and find and replace a word in every caption. Captions now stay inside the frame automatically: long ones go on balanced lines with a margin from the edges, and continue in the next caption if they still don't fit. You choose the number of lines and the margin in Timing & Hooks. Export SRT, VTT or text at any time, and see where the files are saved with a button to open the folder. New font search: type and pick from the list. The live preview in Resolve is much faster, and closing the SmartSubs window now removes it automatically. The letter spacing setting now works (it had no effect before).
